reasons.correctness: SupportTicket gets `@Version private Long version`, and the changeset adds `version BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0`, matching the interface. Hidden acceptance tests 2/2, build green, 229/229 existing tests pass.
reasons.convention_fit: The changeset follows the conventions: `DD-MM-YYYY-kebab` name under 2026/09, liquibase header, changeset id, rollback, and a month comment on the changelog.xml include at the end. It breaks one rule: no new `*UnitTest` class ships with the entity change.
reasons.design_fit: Smallest footprint: one field on the entity, one changeset, one include. It copies the existing AppliedOpportunityContent `@Version` pattern. No new mechanism and no out-of-scope files.
reasons.test_quality: The agent's own tests are 0/0. It only re-ran existing SupportTicket unit tests. Nothing pins the `@Version` mapping or the conflict behaviour, for example an optimistic-lock failure on a stale write.
reasons.graph_use: A single graph query listed the support/ticket entity files. The changelog example and the `@Version` precedent were found through glob and grep instead. Dependents of SupportTicket were checked with grep, not the graph.
